_docs._comment: Behavython CLI config. Copy this file, remove the _docs block, and fill in your values.
_docs._input_folder: Folder containing all animal files. The pipeline auto-discovers and groups them by animal ID.
_docs._input_files: Advanced: explicit file list. Only use if your folder layout is non-standard. Ignored when input_folder is set.
_docs._config_path: Required for open_field / elevated_plus_maze if animals lack individual config JSONs. Set to null otherwise.
_docs._trim_amount: Seconds to skip at the start of the recording.
_docs._crop_video: If true, only the window [trim_amount to (trim_amount + task_duration)] is analyzed.
